summary: Ran a dual-agent Impeccable design critique of the apps/app Gizmo web UI (assessment A: qualitative design review; assessment B: detector scan). Produced a 31/40 design health score with 3 P1s (contrast, 10px type floor, phantom --space-7 token) and several P2s/minor items, persisted a snapshot to apps/app/.impeccable/critique/2026-09-01T22-36-55Z__apps-app.md, and began executing the user-selected 'Everything in the report' fix plan. Initial execution focused on locating files to edit: grepping for text-faint usages across styles, locating the single --space-7 usage, identifying 10px font violations, and reading tokens-base.css and theme files to plan accent darkening for contrast compliance.
decisions: Target the audit at apps/app since it is the only UI surface and the only candidate with PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md present.
Run Assessment A (qualitative design review) and Assessment B (detector + browser evidence) as two isolated subagents in parallel rather than sequentially.
Skip the browser visualization step of Assessment B because no browser automation tools are available in this session; record fallback signal only.
Design Health Score = 31/40 with 3 P1 issues and several P2s; treat as backlog baseline (first snapshot for this target).
Persist snapshot path: apps/app/.impeccable/critique/2026-09-01T22-36-55Z__apps-app.md; trend entry appended.

User selected 'Everything in the report' scope, so the fix plan covers all P1s + P2s + minor observations (contrast, type floor, phantom token, deletion UX, failure surfaces, off-scale radii, /reload dedupe, nth-child selector, Preview badge, compact-context tooltip, Escape boolean, About shortcut list, usage-meter animation, titlebar a11y).
Plan to fix the P1 phantom token by replacing --space-7 with --space-8 (32px) since the spacing scale jumps 1..6 → 8.

Plan to fix the P1 contrast issue by darkening only the default root (light) theme's --color-accent from #d54f35 and updating --focus-ring rgb() to match, leaving themes.css and themes-solarized.css dark-theme accents untouched for this pass.

Treat text-faint as decorative-only in markdown.css (code comments) and convert all semantic-content usages (streaming counter, session sub-labels, titlebar-center, sidebar layout, sessions list, tool-call output) to text-muted for AA contrast compliance.
Defer running `npx impeccable update` to a later turn at the user's request; do not run it as part of this audit work.
Do NOT repair CONTEXT_STALE drift as a side effect of the design task; report findings only.
errors: MONOREPO_TARGET_REQUIRED warning when running context.mjs with --target apps/app from apps/app cwd — targetPath resolved as not existing, but PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md still loaded from apps/app so it was treated as non-blocking.
